title: Bye, lubak! Valenzuela's Maysan Road rehab nears completion, says DPWH
summary: The rehabilitation of Maysan Road in Valenzuela City is nearing completion after more than four months of repair work, Public Works Secretary Banoy Lopez said Tuesday.
